Description
Our Pacific Jacket combines the utility of a mechanic's jacket with the timeless design of a classic chore coat. This cropped-fit silhouette features thoughtful details such as a gusseted shoulder for range of motion, side-seam waist pockets lined with warm corduroy, chest patch pockets with snap closures, interior welt pockets, a two-way front zip and adjustable waistband tabs for a customizable fit. This version is made from jungle cloth, woven to the same specifications as the USN-issued fabric during WWII, offering exceptional sturdiness, weather resistance and wind resistance. For added warmth, it's lined with padded thermal satin to provide insulation while maintaining ease of movement, along with a corduroy cotton collar for a touch of texture.
Details
• Shell: 100% cotton, jungle cloth woven in Japan.
• Lining: 100% polyester satin, woven in Italy. The lining is diamond quilted with a Primaloft® Gold fill.
• Collar and pocket linings: 100% cotton, corduroy woven in Japan.
• Knickerbocker branded spring snaps.
• Custom-developed two-way YKK zipper.
Leather zipper puller.
Made in Portugal.
Care
Hand wash or dry clean.
